title: On the rainbow Cameron-Erdős problem with respect to generalized Sidon sets of multidimensional grids
summary: For positive integers $n$, $d$, $k$ and $h$, let $[n]^d$ be the $d$-dimensional grid of order $n$, and we refer to the equation $\sum_{i=1}^{h}x_{1,i}=\cdots =\sum_{i=1}^{h}x_{k,i}$ as the {\it $B_{k,h}$-equation}, where $x_{1,1}, \ldots, x_{1,h}, \ldots, x_{k,1}, \ldots, x_{k,h}$ are $kh$ points in $[n]^d$. In this paper, we study the rainbow Cameron-Erdős problem with respect to the $B_{k,h}$-equation.
